description: Added from Rust when the app starts (windows.rs), not listed in tauri.conf.json. What the settings window may do: Zajil's own commands and events, its own title, the system's open and save dialogs (the download folder, an import or export file) and its yes-or-no question (deleting the video tools), and turning launching at login on or off. Nothing else: no file system, no shell, no network from the page.
